name: Fear-extreme contrarian gated on range_position at cycle low (capitulation confluence, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: same forced-seller-vs-patient-capital thesis, but the washout gate is range_position (where price sits in its recent high-low channel) rather than a volatility z-score. When fear is extreme AND price sits near the BOTTOM of its range (range_position below a fitted floor), the panic is happening at a level where accumulators historically step in; mid-range fear is not a capitulation. This tests whether a POSITION-in-range gauge — orthogonal to volatility-normalized bb_z — carries the same confluence edge. Long spot; exit when fear relieves or range_position recovers, or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: if range_position-gated entries are indistinguishable from bb_z-gated ones, the specific gauge is noise; keep only if the range floor adds trades or lift the vol-z gauge misses. Kill if net-of-fee return does not beat buy-and-hold on the same low-range days.
catalyst: extreme fear while price sits at the bottom of its range
